entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand. This is completely unacceptable. I want my money back, now.

I can certainly look into that for you, and I understand your frustration. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

What kind of a stupid question is that? The issue is I couldn't return it! I've had a massive family emergency. My husband had to be rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery. I've practically been living there for the last two weeks!
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope your husband is recovering well. I completely understand that would take priority over everything else.

You're damn right it does. And on top of it, my son's deployment got moved up. I've been dealing with that, too. I don't have time for restrictive policies. If you don't refund this, I'm calling my bank and posting reviews on every website you can imagine. Get me a manager.

I understand your position completely, and there's no need for a manager. I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Dealing with a hospital stay and a military deployment at the same time sounds incredibly stressful. Let me just pull up your order and check the policy for you right now. One moment.
Fine. But this better be quick.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I have your order here. I see the VeloBand was delivered 17 days ago. Let me just check the return window... Yes, it looks like our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.

That's correct. You are well within the timeframe. There's no need for any special exception. I can process this as a standard return for a full refund right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Oh. Wow. Okay. I... I'm so sorry. I was just expecting a fight. It's been a very, very difficult time. Thank you. I appreciate you making this easy.
It's completely understandable. I'm glad I could help. The email with the return label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
